objective: Read under a frozen contract dim K_k for n = 4, 8, 16 and k up to 3, and whether the (l + 1)^2 known elements span K_1.
status: Closed 2026-11-10 (exploratory, exact; pre-registered in 0596397e3 and 1115cfa1e): P1 holds (K_1 is spanned by the (l+1)^2 inverse-counting identities at n = 4, 8, 16); P2 is refuted (the kernel fraction falls, 0.73, 0.49, 0.32 at k = 2, but is not below 1% at n = 16), triggering stop rule (b); the killed family is the identities times row-linear monomials, its fraction tracking (l+1)^2 k / v. The rule's reading that the route cannot give a dense separated space does not follow (logged in docs/CORRECTIONS.md).
title: The decoder's kernel on small instances
